what_changed_vs_s0: the mask head and every mask tensor are removed: no mask_net forward, no mask in the score, no replacement by an all-ones mask
the sparsity term lambda_sparse * mean(|m_s|) (2.0 in S0) is removed
the score becomes 100 * <normalize(clip_image), normalize(clip_text)> instead of 100 * cos(normalize(v_i * m_j), t_j)

what_is_unchanged_vs_s0.view: repo reference openai-clip _transform(224), single view, no view_b
what_is_unchanged_vs_s0.precision: fp32 master weights + bf16 autocast encoders, fp32 normalisation and both cross entropies
what_is_unchanged_vs_s0.distributed: autograd-aware nn_dist.all_gather, local anchors, global targets rank*B+i, standard DDP mean

comparison_with_frozen_s0_at_500.note: S0@500 is the frozen reference run and was NOT retrained; its numbers are reused as recorded

stream_verification.scope: rank0 only (every arm logs rank0 rows; statistics_scope = rank0_local_batch)
stream_verification.per_step_digests_vs_pgclip_v01_step500: 51/51 identical (batch_image_id_sha256, batch_caption_sha256); PG logs no prefix_k/sample_id field and no cumulative digest, so those are NOT COMPARABLE
stream_verification.cumulative_streams_vs_cgclip_v01_step500: all four streams identical at 51/51 steps (caption, image_id, prefix_k, sample); key names differ and are mapped explicitly
stream_verification.independent_rebuild: manifest + DistributedSampler(seed=0), epoch 0, rank 0, no image decoding: image_id 51/51 and sample_id 51/51 identical under the trainer's float32 digest convention; 0/51 under raw int64 bytes, which is reported as the convention dependence it is

not_comparable.s0_continue_1000_and_pgclip_cont1000: steps 510..1000, zero overlap with this run

covers: bidirectional loss and all gradients equal an independently written reference
the score uses the fixed 100 scale and is unaffected by perturbing logit_scale
mask_net and logit_scale stay frozen while the backbone really updates
the real training step reports zero mask-head gradient tensors
two-rank DDP gradient equals the mean of the two local gradients (and differs from each, so the test is not vacuous)
the single-process loss equals the local anchor definition
checkpoint and bare student load with strict=True and their digests recompute
partition_parameters refuses a model that lacks the compatibility keys

corrections.export_probe_labels: the export tool originally labelled the trained-vs-untrained probe as 'lossless_probe'. The metadata now separates probe_after_two_independent_loads_max_abs_diff (0.0 / 0.0, the real losslessness test) from probe_trained_vs_untrained_max_abs_diff (1.3013 / 0.3430, expected to be non-zero). No weight and no metric changed.
corrections.stream_comparison_wording: an earlier internal statement called the cross-arm stream comparison '51/51 identical on all digests'. The honest scope is: the two per-step fields PG logs and the four cumulative streams CG logs; PG has no prefix_k or cumulative field at all, and the S0 / HS logs are either non-overlapping or unparseable.

not_run: control arms (mask only, sparsity only, other sparsity weights, longer budgets)
hyper-parameter search, extra seeds, continuation beyond 500 steps
per-rank stream comparison (only rank0 is logged)
prefix-stream comparison against PG-CLIP (PG does not log the field)
comparison with the original S0 500-step log (not on this machine; available S0 logs do not overlap in step number)
